page.layout: One page of running text in one column. Above the text: the page number at the top left and the running head at the top centre. Then a centred article heading in spaced capitals, and below it an italic summary line set apart. The body is one column of justified text with no marginal notes. Below the last line, at the right, the catchword "igitur".

main_text.l: ARTICVLVS VIII.
Quo ex aliis Aristotelica similitudinis improbatione
veritas magis ac magis illustratur.
Frustra verò id Aristoteles tentarit ostendere si-
militudine ejus qui ex eodem vase jaciat glo-
bum, tesseram, turbinem & columellam; nempe unum-
quodque, inquit, eorum accommodatè suæ formæ mo-
vebitur. Aut si quis animal unum aquatile, aliudque
terrestre, & aliud volucre à sinu suo emittat: planum
est enim quòd natatile eò profiliens enataverit, ubi ei
commodum est victitare; terrestre ad suas ædes, pascua-
que sua erepserit: at aërium è terra sublime raptum
evolaverit: una utique eademque prima causa pro-
prium eorum unicuique aptitudinem reddente. Ea-
demque ratio est in mundo. Si quidem ab una cœli
universi conversione quæ die noctèque finitur, alia,
atque alia permeationes fiunt. Parum, inquam, com-
moda similitudines, quibus nihil aliud quàm petitur
principium, dum idipsum quod similitudine decla-
randum erat, pro simili usurpatur.
Propositerat enim Aristoteles ostendere quomo-
do divinitati maximè sit consentaneum, ut formas
rerum omnium citra difficultatem, simplicique motu
absolvat. Ejusdem prorsus est rationis: quomodo
res omnes naturales eodem motu faciat, atque re-
gat: & quidem qui unum norit, omnia norit. hoc
Aristoteles ostendit jactu globi; tesseræ, turbinis &
columellæ. At priusquam jacerentur, hæc diversi-
modè facta sunt, non eodem motu: ergo si valida
sit similitudo, potiùs ostendunt Deum diversis mo-
tibus, diversorumque instrumentorum, ac virtutum
usu, hæc tam diversa fabricasse. Vel sanè quod quæ-
rebatur quomodo Deus unico motu tam discrepan-
tia faciat, debuit ostendere; quod non fecit. Nihil
igitur

page.notes: Printed "Proposuerat.enim" reads as "Proposuerat enim" with a stop-like mark between the words, transcribed as a space. "ut formas rerum omnium citra difficultatem," is set in italic and transcribed as such. The first letter of "Frustra" is a large initial F, joined to the word. The word "quærebatur" is hyphenated at the line end as "quæreba-tur"; transcribed as one word. The word "igitur" at the foot is treated as a catchword. Its following text is not on this scan. Two printed errors kept as printed: "Proposuerat" with the stop-like mark and "si-militudine" hyphenated at the line end.
